Procedure: Using the Fluke 87 current measuring instrument and the MCS-5N timer

sections_en.text: This document sets out the test steps for the earth-fault protection device mentioned above. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at the New Assiut Power Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the field test was carried out by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed on 22 April 2003.

items: The unit is out of service
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs.
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment

sections_en.text: Work Steps to be Carried Out

rows: Verify that switch 43-64GE (OFF/NORMAL/TEST) is in the Normal position
Set the variable resistor to its highest value
Connect one terminal of the variable resistor to point (6) on the relay (64GE) from the back
Reduce the resistance gradually until the Operation signal drops
Remove the variable resistor terminals from the relay and the earth
Record the measured value of the variable resistor using the True RMS Multimeter Type Fluke 87

Connect one terminal of the Switch to point (6) on the relay (64GE) from the back, and the other terminal of the Switch to the variable resistor, and the other terminal of the variable resistor to earth
Connect the Start terminals of the timer to the Switch terminals
Connect the Stop terminals of the timer to points (4,6) on the relay (64GE) from the back, figure No. 2
Switch the Switch to the ON position
Remove the wire terminals connected to points (4,6) on the relay (64GE) from the back

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Protection – Generation | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: EFR-013-r0a | Equipment: Rotor earth-fault protection x64GE, TCR3D-BSI, Toshiba
Issued to: Assiut Power Station
Status: APPROVED
Approval date: 03 July 2003 | Procedure: Using the Fluke 87 current measuring instrument and the MCS-5N timer
Next review date: July 2008
Introduction
This document sets out the test steps for the earth-fault protection device mentioned above. The first draft was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at the New Assiut Power Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the field test was carried out by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed on 22 April 2003.
Safety Precautions
The unit is out of service
Open a work order
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs.
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Variable resistor, 25 kΩ
True RMS Multimeter type Fluke 78
Millisecond Counter (Timer) type MCS-5N
Test leads
Switch (2 Pole)
Variable resistor, 25 kΩ
True RMS Multimeter type Fluke 78
Millisecond Counter (Timer) type MCS-5N
Test leads
Switch (2 Pole)
Work Steps to be Carried Out
...
Verify that switch 43-64GE (OFF/NORMAL/TEST) is in the Normal position | 1
Set the variable resistor to its highest value | 2
Connect one terminal of the variable resistor to point (6) on the relay (64GE) from the back | 3
Reduce the resistance gradually until the Operation signal drops | 4
Remove the variable resistor terminals from the relay and the earth | 5
Record the measured value of the variable resistor using the True RMS Multimeter Type Fluke 87 | 6
Connect one terminal of the Switch to point (6) on the relay (64GE) from the back, and the other terminal of the Switch to the variable resistor, and the other terminal of the variable resistor to earth | 7
Connect the Start terminals of the timer to the Switch terminals | 8
Connect the Stop terminals of the timer to points (4,6) on the relay (64GE) from the back, figure No. 2 | 9
Reset the timer | 10
Switch the Switch to the ON position | 11
Record the time value (Operating Time) | 12
Remove the wire terminals connected to points (4,6) on the relay (64GE) from the back | 13
Reset the protection device (64GE) | 14
